title: Mise-en-Video: Fine-Grained 3D Control for Multi-Shot Video Generation
title_zh: Mise-en-Video：面向多镜头视频生成的细粒度3D控制

paragraphs.en: Recent advances in text-to-video generation have enabled high-fidelity single-shot synthesis, yet practical storytelling creation requires multi-shot videos with both strong inter-shot consistency and fine-grained controllability. Existing multi-shot video generation approaches achieve strong consistency but still fall short in controllability. In this paper, we propose Mise-en-Video ( MeV ), a highly controllable multi-shot video generation framework that allows video creators to conduct staging the multi-shot in the 3D space and then generate the corresponding multi-shot video. To achieve this, our framework combines a hierarchical attention mechanism for multi-level narrative consistency with 3D-aware layout guidance for precise, per-shot spatial control. To support training and evaluation, we develop standardized annotation pipelines and construct a 160K-video dataset with hierarchical multi-shot texts and oriented 3D bounding boxes. Extensive experiments demonstrate that MeV consistently outperforms strong baselines in video quality, inter-shot consistency, and subject-level controllability. Project page: https://heiheishuang.xyz/Mise-en-Video .
paragraphs.zh: 文本到视频生成的最新进展已实现了高保真的单镜头合成，但实际的叙事创作需要多镜头视频，同时具备强镜头间一致性和细粒度可控性。 现有的多镜头视频生成方法实现了强一致性，但在可控性方面仍有不足。 本文提出 Mise-en-Video（MeV），这是一个高度可控的多镜头视频生成框架，允许视频创作者在3D空间中对多镜头进行场面调度，然后生成相应的多镜头视频。 为实现这一目标，我们的框架将用于多层级叙事一致性的分层注意力机制与用于精确、逐镜头空间控制的3D感知布局引导相结合。 为支持训练与评估，我们开发了标准化标注流水线，并构建了一个包含16万个视频、带有分层多镜头文本和带方向3D边界框的数据集。 大量实验表明，MeV 在视频质量、镜头间一致性和主体级可控性方面始终优于强基线方法。 项目页面：https://heiheishuang.xyz/Mise-en-Video 。

paragraphs.en: With the continuous iteration and maturity of text-to-video generation technology [ 36 , 21 , 35 ] , it has been widely applied in artistic creation, film production, and other fields, and has become an important technical support in the field of content production. However, the current mainstream video generation models still have obvious limitations. Although they perform well in synthesizing high-fidelity single-shot videos, they find it difficult to meet the more complex content needs in practical applications. In narrative scenarios such as film and television, the presentation of long-form stories often relies on the organic combination of multiple shots [ 12 ] , which is still a challenging and open problem for current video generation models. Especially the difficulty in simultaneously ensuring inter-shot consistency and fine-grained controllability, which has become a key bottleneck restricting the practical application of T2V technology.

paragraphs.en: Multi-shot video generation puts higher requirements on generation models in two aspects: consistency and controllability. First, to achieve coherent narrative expression, the generated multi-shot videos must maintain consistency in the background environment, core theme, and characters across shots. Second, beyond mere narrative stability, professional content creation requires granular steerability over the generative process. As creators seek to move past randomized outputs, the focus has shifted toward precisely manipulating key cinematic elements, such as shot composition, subject positions, and camera angles, making controllable multi-shot generation a pivotal frontier in the field.
paragraphs.zh: 多镜头视频生成在两个方面对生成模型提出了更高的要求：一致性与可控性。 首先，为了实现连贯的叙事表达，生成的多镜头视频必须在背景环境、核心主题和角色方面跨镜头保持一致性。 其次，超越单纯的叙事稳定性之外，专业内容创作需要对生成过程进行细粒度的可控性。 随着创作者力求摆脱随机化的输出，焦点已转向精确操控关键电影元素，例如镜头构图、主体位置和机位角度，这使得可控的多镜头生成成为该领域的关键前沿。

paragraphs.en: Existing multi-shot video generation methods generally follow two paradigms: decoupled generation and one-time generation. Earlier decoupled approaches [ 45 , 54 ] generate shots independently and splice them together; while this allows for individual shot control, it often fails to maintain inter-shot consistency in identity and style. Conversely, one-time generation methods [ 29 , 43 , 18 , 3 ] leverage cross-shot attention to ensure global coherence, yet they often trade off fine-grained controllability. Most such models solely rely on text prompts for each shot to guide shot generation, which we observe to be insufficient for complex creation.
paragraphs.zh: 现有的多镜头视频生成方法通常遵循两种范式：解耦生成和一次性生成。 早期的解耦方法 [45, 54] 独立生成各个镜头再将其拼接在一起；虽然这样可以实现对单个镜头的控制，但往往无法保持镜头间在身份和风格上的一致性。 相反，一次性生成方法 [29, 43, 18, 3] 利用跨镜头注意力来保证全局连贯性，但它们往往牺牲了细粒度的可控性。 这类模型大多仅依赖每个镜头的文本提示来引导镜头生成，我们观察到这对于复杂的创作而言是不够的。

paragraphs.en: Specifically, our key observation is that such a text attention mechanism ignores the fact that the videos are projections of 3D scenes and video creators (directors) usually first conduct 3D staging to determine the subject layout and then fill in the details for each subject. In contrast, current multi-shot generation methods directly input all the textual details of each shot and leave the video generation model to determine the subject layout. This causes the following two issues. 1. Confusion of spatial relationships: Text descriptions are often underspecified or ambiguous regarding 3D geometry, and without explicit 3D modeling, the generated shots may exhibit inconsistent depth ordering and unreasonable spatial layouts. 2. Inability to control dynamic movements: Text prompts naturally lack the spatial awareness, making them hard to specify subject motions such as movement trajectories and turning directions. However, to ensure the correct narrative, video creators have a strong need to specify the movement and actions of actors.
paragraphs.zh: 具体而言，我们的关键观察是：这种文本注意力机制忽略了这样一个事实——视频是三维场景的投影，而视频创作者（导演）通常首先进行三维布景以确定主体布局，然后再为每个主体填充细节。 相比之下，当前的多镜头生成方法直接输入每个镜头的所有文本细节，并将主体布局的确定留给视频生成模型。 这会导致以下两个问题。 1. 空间关系混乱：文本描述在三维几何方面往往不够明确或存在歧义，在没有显式三维建模的情况下，生成的镜头可能出现深度排序不一致和空间布局不合理的问题。 2. 无法控制动态运动：文本提示天然缺乏空间感知能力，因此难以指定主体的运动，例如移动轨迹和转向方向。 然而，为了确保叙事正确，视频创作者非常需要指定演员的运动和动作。

Directly staging the plot in the 3D space not only ensures the correctness of 3D spatial relationships but also enables precisely specifying the dynamics of subjects in the 3D space.

paragraphs.en: Designing such a 3D-aware multi-shot video generation method is non-trivial. Such a framework requires taking both the text prompts and 3D layout as conditions into a 2D video generation, which suffers from severe modality mismatch. First, the 3D layout designed by the creators needs to be converted into effective 2D control signals for video generation. However, fine-grained 3D geometry information, such as point clouds or depth maps, is not only hard to obtain but also lacks flexibility in practical creation. Meanwhile, simply adopting coarse 3D bounding boxes cannot accurately control the detailed behaviors of subjects, such as character turning and posture adjustment. Therefore, it is still a challenge to design a flexible but steerable 2D control from the 3D layout. Second, how to effectively associate the subject textual descriptions with the specific 3D subject still remains unexplored. A multi-shot video generation usually involves multiple subjects. Simply associating each video shot with the shot description without subject-level association often leads to confusion about the subject.
paragraphs.zh: 设计这样一种具有3D感知能力的多镜头视频生成方法并非易事。 这样的框架需要将文本提示词和3D布局共同作为条件引入2D视频生成中，而这会面临严重的模态不匹配问题。 首先，创作者设计的3D布局需要被转换为有效的2D控制信号以用于视频生成。 然而，细粒度的3D几何信息（如点云或深度图）不仅难以获取，而且在实际创作中缺乏灵活性。 同时，简单地采用粗糙的3D边界框无法准确控制主体的细节行为，例如角色的转身和姿态调整。 因此，如何从3D布局中设计一种灵活且可控的2D控制方式仍然是一个挑战。 其次，如何有效地将主体的文本描述与特定的3D主体相关联仍有待探索。 多镜头视频生成通常涉及多个主体。 仅仅将每个视频镜头与镜头描述相关联而不进行主体级别的关联，往往会导致主体混淆。

paragraphs.en: To address the above challenges, we adopt two key designs. First, we design a Subject Layout Guidance to convert 3D layouts into 2D control signals. Considering the trade-off between control flexibility and representational complexity, we represent each subject using oriented 3D bounding boxes. This representation is intentionally lightweight, allowing creators to intuitively define the 3D layout and blocking of a scene without the need for exhaustive geometric modeling. To bridge the gap between coarse boxes and fine-grained subject dynamics, we propose a NOCS [ 37 ] -based (Normalized Object Coordinate Space) color encoding scheme. By mapping canonical coordinates onto the 3D boxes, we transform abstract orientations and movements, such as a character turning or tilting, into dense, orientation-aware visual cues. These 3D representations are projected into the 2D camera view to form per-frame layout maps. To resolve the modality mismatch between 3D-structured signals and 2D pixel generation, we employ a ControlNet-like structure to inject these signals into the Diffusion Transformer (DiT) backbone.

paragraphs.en: Then, to effectively associate the subject texts with the subject bounding box, we adopt the Hierarchical Context Attention mechanism. paragraphs.en: The advent of Diffusion Transformer (DiT) [ 32 ] architectures has brought substantial improvements to the video generation in visual quality, duration, and text prompt following [ 2 , 8 , 55 ] . The widely-used HunyuanVideo [ 21 ] and Wan [ 36 ] are constructed by significantly scaling up model capacity and training data, paving the way for the community to delve into fresh frontiers of world modeling and its diverse applications. To further push the boundary of single-shot video length, several works have explored autoregressive and streaming generation paradigms. FramePack [ 49 ] proposes a structured frame packing strategy that compresses historical context into compact representations, allowing the model to generate videos of arbitrary length in a sliding-window fashion while maintaining temporal consistency. Self-Forcing [ 16 ] addresses the training-inference discrepancy in autoregressive video generation by training the model to condition on its own previously generated frames, enabling stable long-video synthesis without exposure bias. Despite these advances in generating longer and more temporally coherent single-shot videos [ 15 , 46 ] , they remain fundamentally constrained to a single continuous camera shot. Such single-shot video generation lacks narrative expressiveness and is unable to convey rich information through varied shots as films do, making it difficult to captivate audiences for extended viewing.
paragraphs.zh: 扩散Transformer（DiT）[32]架构的出现，为视频生成在视觉质量、时长和文本提示遵循方面带来了显著提升[2, 8, 55]。 广泛使用的HunyuanVideo [21]和Wan [36]通过大幅扩展模型容量和训练数据构建而成，为社区深入探索世界建模及其多样化应用的新前沿铺平了道路。 为了进一步突破单次生成视频长度的边界，一些工作探索了自回归和流式生成范式。 FramePack [49]提出了一种结构化的帧打包策略，将历史上下文压缩为紧凑的表示，使模型能够以滑动窗口的方式生成任意长度的视频，同时保持时间一致性。 Self-Forcing [16]通过训练模型以其自身先前生成的帧为条件，解决了自回归视频生成中训练与推理之间的不一致问题，从而在没有曝光偏差的情况下实现稳定的长视频合成。 尽管在生成更长且时间上更连贯的单次视频方面取得了这些进展[15, 46]，它们在根本上仍然受限于单个连续的摄像机镜头。 这种单镜头视频生成缺乏叙事表现力，无法像电影那样通过多变的镜头传达丰富的信息，因而难以让观众长时间保持观看兴趣。

paragraphs.en: With the rapid advancement of single-shot video generation methods [ 36 , 35 ] , these models have been widely adopted in commercial scenarios such as advertisement production and media content creation. Consequently, the research focus is shifting from single-shot to multi-shot video generation [ 12 , 18 , 3 , 29 , 43 , 38 , 28 , 40 ] . This emerging paradigm aims to generate videos composed of multiple shots while maintaining subject and scene consistency across varying camera perspectives, thereby facilitating complex narrative storytelling. Existing multi-shot video generation methods generally fall into two categories. The first category [ 54 , 45 ] employs a two-stage approach: it initially generates the starting frame of each shot and subsequently uses an image-to-video method to extend them. However, this approach yields suboptimal results, as consistency is only guaranteed across the initial frames. The second category [ 29 , 43 , 40 , 18 , 3 ] leverages contextual learning to model the relationships between shots, ensuring better global consistency. Although effective, these models [ 29 , 18 , 3 , 43 ] suffer from limited controllability, as they can only guide the generated content through text prompts, making it difficult for users to achieve their precise desired outcomes.
paragraphs.zh: 随着单镜头视频生成方法 [ 36 , 35 ] 的快速进步，这些模型已被广泛应用于广告制作和媒体内容创作等商业场景。 因此，研究重点正从单镜头转向多镜头视频生成 [ 12 , 18 , 3 , 29 , 43 , 38 , 28 , 40 ] 。 这一新兴范式旨在生成由多个镜头组成的视频，同时在不同镜头视角下保持主体和场景的一致性，从而助力复杂的叙事表达。 现有的多镜头视频生成方法大致可分为两类。 第一类方法 [ 54 , 45 ] 采用两阶段策略：先生成每个镜头的起始帧，随后使用图像到视频的方法对其进行扩展。 然而，这种方法效果欠佳，因为一致性仅在起始帧之间得到保证。 第二类方法 [ 29 , 43 , 40 , 18 , 3 ] 利用上下文学习来建模镜头之间的关系，从而确保更好的全局一致性。 尽管有效，这些模型 [ 29 , 18 , 3 , 43 ] 的可控性有限，因为它们只能通过文本提示来引导生成内容，使用户难以精确实现其预期效果。

paragraphs.en: Precise controllability is essential for user-directed video generation. Recent methods control camera motion [ 13 , 10 , 9 , 1 , 25 , 5 ] , visual style [ 47 , 24 ] , subject identity [ 19 , 17 ] , object motion in driving scenes [ 22 , 57 , 53 , 7 , 11 , 6 , 23 ] , and human motion [ 14 , 56 , 52 , 4 ] . CameraCtrl [ 13 ] , CineMaster [ 39 ] , and CamCloneMaster [ 27 ] control camera motion, while VACE [ 19 ] and ConceptMaster [ 17 ] preserve subject identity. Despite their effectiveness, a major limitation of these approaches is that they are predominantly restricted to single-shot settings. Driving-oriented methods mainly use layouts or bounding boxes to control object positions and trajectories in structured road scenes, whereas our setting targets 3D subject placement and orientation across cinematic shots. To address multi-shot controllability, MultiShotMaster [ 40 ] recently proposed the first controllable multi-shot video generation framework. However, its controllability remains confined to the 2D domain, limiting fine-grained control over subject orientation and spatial positioning critical for cinematic storytelling. Thus, we propose a fine-grained, 3D-controlled multi-shot video generation model, empowering creators with precise spatial control for complex video production.

sents.en: Thus, we propose a fine-grained, 3D-controlled multi-shot video generation model, empowering creators with precise spatial control for complex video production.

paragraphs.en: We propose MeV for coherent multi-shot storytelling video generation conditioned on hierarchical text and explicit subject-level layout control. We first introduce Subject Layout Guidance by encoding each subject with oriented 3D bounding boxes and a NOCS-based representation, projecting them into per-frame 2D layout maps and injecting them into the ControlDiT backbone to precisely control subject placement and facing direction over time (Sec. 3.2.2 ). We then decompose the caption into global, shot, and subject levels and fuse them with a Hierarchical Context Attention mechanism to improve narrative consistency and subject coherence across shots (Sec. 3.2.3 ). To support large-scale training, we also build a multi-shot video annotation pipeline that provides hierarchical captions and shot-wise subject layout supervision (Sec. 3.3 ).
paragraphs.zh: 我们提出 MeV，用于在分层文本和显式主体级布局控制的条件下进行连贯的多镜头叙事视频生成。 我们首先引入主体布局引导（Subject Layout Guidance），通过为每个主体编码带朝向的 3D 包围盒和基于 NOCS 的表示，将其投影为逐帧的 2D 布局图，并注入 ControlDiT 骨干网络，从而精确控制主体随时间的放置位置与朝向（Sec. 3.2.2 ）。 然后我们将字幕分解为全局、镜头和主体三个层级，并通过分层上下文注意力机制将其融合，以提升跨镜头的叙事一致性和主体连贯性（Sec. 3.2.3 ）。 为支持大规模训练，我们还构建了一个多镜头视频标注流水线，提供分层字幕和逐镜头的主体布局监督（Sec. 3.3 ）。

paragraphs.en: To achieve precise control over multi-shot video generation, we introduce a 3D-aware subject layout control mechanism inspired by cinematic mise-en-scène, as shown in Fig. 2 . Formally, we define a storytelling video scene as a collection of shots 𝒮 = { S 1 , S 2 , … , S K } \mathcal{S}=\{S_{1},S_{2},\dots,S_{K}\} . Within any given shot S k S_{k} , we represent M M active subjects as a set of time-varying, oriented 3D bounding boxes { B i , f } i = 1 M ∈ ℝ 3 × 8 \{B_{i,f}\}_{i=1}^{M}\in\mathbb{R}^{3\times 8} , where f f denotes the frame index. To capture fine-grained geometric properties beyond simple spatial occupancy, we apply a Normalized Object Coordinate Space (NOCS) encoding function Φ ⁡ ( ⋅ ) \Phi(\cdot) to these bounding boxes. This NOCS-based color encoding transforms abstract 3D rotations and local coordinate semantics into dense, orientation-aware visual cues, enabling accurate perception of intricate subject dynamics, such as a character turning or adjusting their posture in 3D space.

paragraphs.en: In our framework, as shown in “Hierarchical Caption” of Fig. 2 , the complete textual prompt T T is decoupled into three semantic levels: a global caption T G T_{G} dictating the overall style and narrative, a set of shot-level captions { T S k } k = 1 K \{T_{S_{k}}\}_{k=1}^{K} describing the specific background and action of each shot, and a set of subject-level captions { T O k , i } i = 1 M \{T_{O_{k,i}}\}_{i=1}^{M} detailing the fine-grained attributes of subject O i O_{i} within shot S k S_{k} .
paragraphs.zh: 在我们的框架中，如图 2 的“层级描述（Hierarchical Caption）”所示，完整的文本提示 T T 被解耦为三个语义层级：规定整体风格与叙事的全局描述 T G T_{G}、描述每个镜头具体背景与动作的镜头级描述集合 { T S k } k = 1 K \{T_{S_{k}}\}_{k=1}^{K}，以及详细刻画镜头 S k S_{k} 中主体 O i O_{i} 细粒度属性的主体级描述集合 { T O k , i } i = 1 M \{T_{O_{k,i}}\}_{i=1}^{M}。

paragraphs.en: While the 3D layout control explicitly defines the spatial-temporal dynamics of a subject, we must also ensure that the subject’s appearance aligns strictly with its specific textual description, avoiding semantic bleed across different shots or subjects (e.g., a character’s clothing style leaking into the background). To effectively associate the hierarchical text conditions with their corresponding visual regions, we propose a Hierarchical Context Attention (HCA) mechanism as shown in Fig. 3 , where the subject regions are obtained by projecting the corresponding 3D bounding boxes onto the 2D image plane without requiring additional user specification. Standard cross-attention globally broadcasts all text tokens to all visual tokens, which often leads to attribute confusion in complex multi-shot generation. To mitigate this, HCA modifies the attention weights by introducing a meticulously designed mask matrix that restricts the receptive field of visual tokens.
paragraphs.zh: 虽然3D布局控制明确地定义了主体的时空动态，我们还必须确保主体的外观严格符合其特定的文本描述，避免不同镜头或主体之间的语义渗透（例如，角色的服装风格渗入背景中）。 为了有效地将层级化文本条件与其对应的视觉区域关联起来，我们提出了一种层级化上下文注意力（HCA）机制，如图3所示，其中主体区域通过将相应的3D边界框投影到2D图像平面上获得，无需额外的用户指定。 标准的交叉注意力将所有文本标记全局广播给所有视觉标记，这在复杂的多镜头生成中常导致属性混淆。 为缓解这一问题，HCA通过引入一个精心设计的掩码矩阵来修改注意力权重，从而限制视觉标记的感受野。

paragraphs.en: MeV is trained in a two-stage manner. We first train the Hierarchical Context Attention Mask, which strengthens hierarchical context modeling and improves coherence across multi-shot sequences. We then introduce the Subject Layout injection module and continue training to endow the model with layout-conditioned, subject-level controllability. This second stage is conducted on our annotated dataset of 160k samples; throughout training, we randomly sample clips with different video lengths and varying numbers of shots to enhance robustness to diverse narrative structures.
paragraphs.zh: MeV 采用两阶段方式进行训练。 我们首先训练分层上下文注意力掩码，该掩码强化了分层上下文建模，并提升了多镜头序列之间的连贯性。 随后我们引入主体布局注入模块并继续训练，使模型具备基于布局的主体级可控性。 第二阶段在我们的 16 万条标注样本数据集上进行；在整个训练过程中，我们随机采样具有不同视频时长和不同镜头数量的片段，以增强对多样化叙事结构的鲁棒性。

paragraphs.en: At the data level, to obtain multi-shot videos at sufficient scale, we collect video clips from the Internet, covering sources such as TV series, movies, and documentaries. paragraphs.en: To obtain a 3D layout representation analogous to a “shot blocking sheet,” we perform subject-level geometric construction. Concretely, we first use Detectron2 [ 44 ] to detect subjects in each shot, and then use SAM2 [ 33 ] to track them across frames, obtaining a per-frame mask for each subject. Next, we apply CameraHMR [ 31 ] for human mesh recovery to obtain SMPL-based 3D human representations [ 26 ] . To unify 3D geometric relationships across different subjects and camera viewpoints, we further use Pi3 [ 42 ] to reconstruct the entire scene and recover per-frame depth, and align the SMPL meshes with the depth maps, resulting in subject meshes in a unified scale and coordinate system. Finally, we compute a 3D bounding box that tightly encloses each mesh. Inspired by the NOCS [ 37 , 48 ] , we encode the box in the Normalized Object Coordinate Space (NOCS), which preserves fine-grained geometric information such as orientation. We then project the NOCS-encoded 3D boxes onto the image plane, yielding a 2D layout sequence as the conditioning signal.
paragraphs.zh: 为了获得类似于“镜头分镜表（shot blocking sheet）”的三维布局表示，我们进行主体级的几何构建。 具体而言，我们首先使用 Detectron2 [ 44 ] 检测每个镜头中的主体，然后使用 SAM2 [ 33 ] 跨帧跟踪它们，从而为每个主体获得逐帧掩码。 接下来，我们使用 CameraHMR [ 31 ] 进行人体网格恢复，得到基于 SMPL 的三维人体表示 [ 26 ]。 为了统一不同主体和相机视角之间的三维几何关系，我们进一步使用 Pi3 [ 42 ] 重建整个场景并恢复逐帧深度，并将 SMPL 网格与深度图对齐，从而得到统一尺度和坐标系下的主体网格。 最后，我们计算一个紧密包围每个网格的三维包围盒。 受 NOCS [ 37 , 48 ] 的启发，我们在归一化物体坐标空间（NOCS）中对包围盒进行编码，以保留朝向等细粒度几何信息。 然后，我们将经 NOCS 编码的三维包围盒投影到图像平面上，得到二维布局序列作为条件信号。

paragraphs.en: At the text annotation level, to improve controllability of text conditions and reduce semantic drift during generation, we construct hierarchical captions with three levels: global, shot, and subject. For each multi-shot video, we first use Gemini 3 Flash to generate a global caption for the entire video, focusing on the overall scene and major events; based on this, we further infer shot-level captions conditioned on the content of each shot. For subject-level captions, we first provide Gemini with subject crops from each shot obtained via SAM2 [ 33 ] , and ask it to merge the same subject across the whole video and assign a globally unique subject ID. We then generate a description for each subject conditioned on the global caption, resulting in hierarchical text annotations aligned with the multi-shot structure and suitable for enforcing subject consistency.
paragraphs.zh: 在文本标注层面，为提升文本条件的可控性并减少生成过程中的语义漂移，我们构建了包含全局、镜头和主体三个层级的分层描述。 对于每个多镜头视频，我们首先使用 Gemini 3 Flash 为整个视频生成全局描述，聚焦于整体场景和主要事件；在此基础上，我们进一步以每个镜头的内容为条件推断镜头级描述。 对于主体级描述，我们首先向 Gemini 提供通过 SAM2 [33] 从每个镜头中获得的主体裁剪图像，要求它合并整个视频中的同一主体，并分配全局唯一的主体 ID。 然后我们以全局描述为条件为每个主体生成一段描述，从而得到与多镜头结构对齐、适合用于强制主体一致性的分层文本标注。

paragraphs.en: Our model is built upon a 1B-parameter single-shot text-to-video (T2V) backbone and is trained in two stages. In the first stage, we train the single-shot model with our Hierarchical Captions to enable precise shot-level control and fine-grained subject description. In the second stage, we extend controllability with 3D layout guidance by training only the ControlDiT branch while keeping the rest of the model frozen. We annotate 160K multi-shot videos, each comprising 2–6 shots with up to 250 frames. All experiments are conducted on 32 GPUs with a batch size of 1.

sents.en: In the second stage, we extend controllability with 3D layout guidance by training only the ControlDiT branch while keeping the rest of the model frozen.
sents.zh: 在第二阶段，我们仅训练 ControlDiT 分支并冻结模型的其余部分，从而通过 3D 布局引导扩展可控性。

sents.en: We annotate 160K multi-shot videos, each comprising 2–6 shots with up to 250 frames.
sents.zh: 我们标注了 16 万条多镜头视频，每条视频包含 2–6 个镜头，最多可达 250 帧。

sents.en: All experiments are conducted on 32 GPUs with a batch size of 1.

These prompts cover a wide range of topics, enabling a comprehensive assessment of a model’s ability to maintain consistency across diverse scenarios in multi-shot narrative video generation.

paragraphs.en: We evaluate performance from multiple aspects: (1) Text Alignment: following prior work [ 40 , 28 ] , we compute the similarity between text features and per-shot video features extracted by ViCLIP [ 41 ] . (2) Inter-shot Consistency: we first measure the holistic semantic similarity between ViCLIP shot features; then, on keyframes (first, middle, and last frames), we apply YOLOv11 [ 20 ] and ByteTrack [ 51 ] to detect and crop subjects and backgrounds, and use DINOv2 [ 30 ] feature to quantify subject consistency and scene consistency across shots. (3) Intra-shot Consistency: within each shot, we similarly use YOLOv11 and ByteTrack to crop subjects and backgrounds from keyframes, and employ DINOv2 feature to evaluate subject consistency and scene consistency within the shot. (4) Transition Control: following prior work [ 29 ] , we report the shot cut accuracy score to measure shot-cut accuracy. (5) Overall Quality: following prior work [ 28 , 40 ] , we report Aesthetic Quality and the Narrative Coherence score to assess overall narrative quality. (6) Orientation Quality: We assess controllability by comparing subject orientations in the generated videos and GT, reporting yaw/pitch/roll errors as well as mAOE and OSYaw.
paragraphs.zh: 我们从多个方面评估性能：(1) 文本对齐：遵循先前工作 [40, 28]，我们计算文本特征与 ViCLIP [41] 提取的每个镜头视频特征之间的相似度。 (2) 镜头间一致性：我们首先测量 ViCLIP 镜头特征之间的整体语义相似度；然后，在关键帧（首帧、中间帧和末帧）上，我们应用 YOLOv11 [20] 和 ByteTrack [51] 来检测并裁剪主体和背景，并使用 DINOv2 [30] 特征来量化跨镜头的主体一致性和场景一致性。 (3) 镜头内一致性：在每个镜头内，我们同样使用 YOLOv11 和 ByteTrack 从关键帧中裁剪主体和背景，并采用 DINOv2 特征来评估镜头内的主体一致性和场景一致性。 (4) 转场控制：遵循先前工作 [29]，我们报告镜头切换准确率分数来衡量镜头切换的准确性。 (5) 整体质量：遵循先前工作 [28, 40]，我们报告美学质量和叙事连贯性分数来评估整体叙事质量。 (6) 朝向质量：我们通过比较生成视频与真实值（GT）中的主体朝向来评估可控性，报告偏航/俯仰/翻滚误差以及 mAOE 和 OSYaw。

paragraphs.en: Tab. 1 reports quantitative comparisons with EchoShot [ 38 ] and MultiShotMaster [ 40 ] on multi-shot video generation. Overall, our approach achieves the best performance across all metrics, demonstrating improved visual consistency, text alignment, and narrative quality for multi-shot video generation. For consistency, we outperform prior methods on both intra-shot and inter-shot Subject/Background scores, indicating more stable subjects and backgrounds within each shot and more reliable identity/scene continuity across shot transitions. This gain mainly comes from the Hierarchical Context Attention Mask Mechanism, which enforces constraints over shots and subjects, and the injected 3D layout, which provides an explicit spatial-structure prior. Moreover, our method ranks first in Text Alignment and Narrative Coherence, suggesting better adherence to the text prompt and stronger multi-shot storytelling coherence.
paragraphs.zh: 表 1 报告了在多镜头视频生成上与 EchoShot [38] 和 MultiShotMaster [40] 的定量比较。 总体而言，我们的方法在所有指标上都取得了最佳性能，展现出多镜头视频生成在视觉一致性、文本对齐和叙事质量方面的提升。 在一致性方面，我们在镜头内和镜头间的主体/背景得分上均优于先前的方法，表明每个镜头内的主体和背景更加稳定，且镜头切换间的身份/场景连续性更加可靠。 这一提升主要来自分层上下文注意力掩码机制，它对镜头和主体施加约束；以及注入的 3D 布局，它提供了显式的空间结构先验。 此外，我们的方法在文本对齐和叙事连贯性上排名第一，表明对文本提示的遵循更好，多镜头叙事的连贯性也更强。

paragraphs.en: As shown in Fig. 5 , we compare our method with EchoShot and MultiShotMaster. EchoShot struggles to maintain consistent scenes and subjects under cross-view generation, and its outputs do not align well with the corresponding prompts. MultiShotMaster can preserve subject consistency reasonably well across viewpoints, but it offers limited control over the subject’s motion, making it difficult to precisely satisfy the actions and trajectories required by the storyboard. The full model (Base) delivers the best overall trade-off across key metrics. (1) Notably, removing the mask (w.o. Mask) increases subject and background consistency, but substantially degrades semantic consistency and text alignment, and also weakens transition control and narrative coherence. This indicates that without the mask constraint, the model tends to collapse multi-shot generation into a near single continuous video, yielding superficially consistent subjects/backgrounds but failing to follow shot-wise semantic changes and textual conditions. (2) Removing the subject branch (w.o. Sub) makes the model more compliant in text alignment and transition control, yet it significantly harms cross-shot subject consistency and consequently reduces narrative coherence, highlighting the importance of subject-level hierarchical context for preserving identity across shots. paragraphs.en: Table 3 reports the ablation study to assess the impact of 3D layout guidance. The results show that incorporating 3D layout constraints substantially reduces the overall orientation error (Mean Diff and mAOE) and notably improves yaw alignment (OS Yaw), indicating that the generated camera/subject orientations reliably follow the intended 3D shot plan. This improvement better matches a practical filmmaking workflow, where a director specifies storyboarded shots and camera blocking, and the system “executes” the plan like a cinematographer. Importantly, the gain on yaw is particularly significant: in typical cinematography, yaw (horizontal heading) largely determines key narrative cues such as facing direction, eyeline relationships, and screen-space spatial continuity, whereas pitch often varies less and is generally less decisive for shot-to-shot staging. Overall, this validates that 3D layout guidance enhances controllability and predictability of shot orientation, enabling high-fidelity storyboard-driven generation.
paragraphs.zh: 表3报告了用于评估3D布局引导影响的消融实验。 结果表明，引入3D布局约束显著降低了整体朝向误差（Mean Diff 和 mAOE），并明显改善了偏航对齐（OS Yaw），说明生成的相机/主体朝向能够可靠地遵循预期的3D镜头规划。 这一改进更符合实际的电影制作工作流程，即导演指定分镜镜头与机位调度，而系统像摄影师一样“执行”这一规划。 重要的是，偏航方面的收益尤为显著：在典型的电影摄影中，偏航（水平朝向）在很大程度上决定了面向方向、视线关系和屏幕空间连续性等关键叙事线索，而俯仰角通常变化较小，对镜头之间的场面调度一般也不那么具有决定性。 总体而言，这验证了3D布局引导能够增强镜头朝向的可控性和可预测性，从而实现高保真的分镜驱动生成。

sents.zh: 重要的是，偏航方面的收益尤为显著：在典型的电影摄影中，偏航（水平朝向）在很大程度上决定了面向方向、视线关系和屏幕空间连续性等关键叙事线索，而俯仰角通常变化较小，对镜头之间的场面调度一般也不那么具有决定性。

sents.en: Overall, this validates that 3D layout guidance enhances controllability and predictability of shot orientation, enabling high-fidelity storyboard-driven generation.
sents.zh: 总体而言，这验证了3D布局引导能够增强镜头朝向的可控性和可预测性，从而实现高保真的分镜驱动生成。

At the same time, our method can also vary spatial configurations with the same identity descriptions. This decoupling of 3D spatial layout and semantic descriptions empowers creators with steerability in multi-shot video production.

paragraphs.en: In this work, we propose MeV, a controllable multi-shot video generation framework with both cross-shot consistency and fine-grained controllability. The key idea is to adopt a 3D-aware layout guidance and a hierarchical context attention mechanism to enable the 3D staging in the multi-shot video generation. We further develop an automatic data curation and annotation pipeline and construct a 160K multi-shot dataset for training. We hope this work will inspire future research on production-oriented, 3D-aware controllable multi-shot video generation.
paragraphs.zh: 在本工作中，我们提出 MeV，一个兼具跨镜头一致性与细粒度可控性的可控多镜头视频生成框架。 其核心思想是采用三维感知的布局引导和层级上下文注意力机制，以在多镜头视频生成中实现三维舞台调度。 我们进一步开发了自动化的数据筛选与标注流水线，并构建了一个 160K 规模的多镜头数据集用于训练。 我们希望本工作能启发未来面向生产、三维感知的可控多镜头视频生成研究。

paragraphs.en: While MeV demonstrates strong controllability and consistency, its overall generation quality is still limited by the capacity of the pretrained backbone. With a relatively constrained parameter scale, the model may struggle to generate high-quality dynamic videos. In future work, we plan to scale up the model capacity by adopting larger backbones and/or increasing the parameter budget of the controllable modules.
paragraphs.zh: 尽管 MeV 展现出很强的可控性和一致性，其整体生成质量仍受预训练骨干网络容量的限制。 在参数规模相对受限的情况下，模型可能难以生成高质量的动态视频。 在未来的工作中，我们计划通过采用更大的骨干网络和/或增加可控模块的参数预算来扩展模型容量。
